verses.1: And it came to pass in the seventh year of the reign of Jehoshaphat, in the twentieth day of the month, which was the nineteenth day of the month, that the word of the LORD was revealed to me.
verses.2: Son of Man, write down today’s name and the essence of this day. This day is marked by Babylon’s reign over Jerusalem.
verses.3: And he went into the house of Meri. He said to them, “Thus I say, O Lord Yahweh: Remove the waters from there.”
verses.4: May all good things be upon her, and may she be blessed with chosen ones who will serve her.
verses.5: From the time of selecting the sheep, until their legs are tied together, they will continue to move around, with their legs tied together.
verses.6: Therefore, thus said Adonai Jehovah: “O city of bloodshed! You have been defiled by it. It will not be able to emerge from its destruction. It will not be able to recover from its suffering.”
verses.7: For in its interior, there was a rock covered with grass. It wasn’t poured onto the ground to cover it with sand.
verses.8: To bring about revenge, I have poured out blood upon the rock. So that they cannot cover it up.
verses.9: Therefore, this is what the Lord Jehovah said: “Oh city of bloodshed! I will also increase the suffering of those who suffer.”
verses.10: Many of the trees were burned down by the fire. The leaves and branches were destroyed, and the bark was also damaged.
verses.11: And she was placed on her knees, so that she could be healed. But her skin became blackened and infected inside; her flesh became blackened as well.
verses.12: It will be destroyed completely, and no one will be able to escape from it. It will be destroyed by fire.
verses.13: In your shame, you will be purified. But not by your shame alone. You will not be purified until I lay my love upon you.
verses.14: I, Jehovah, have spoken. I have done what was not right, and I have not acted in accordance with your ways or according to your laws. May the Lord judge you according to your actions!
verses.15: And the word of Jehovah was spoken to me:
verses.16: I will take from you the fire in your eyes during childbirth. Do not weep or grieve; do not let your tears flow.
verses.17: Blood will be wiped away from the dead, but your feet and shoes must not be contaminated. Do not wear shoes on your feet, and do not eat bread from human beings.
verses.18: And I will speak to the people in the morning. My wife will die in the evening. And I will do as I have been commanded.
verses.19: And the people said to him, “Do you not tell us what these things mean? After all, you are the one who does these things.”
verses.20: And He said to them, “These are the words of the LORD to me.”
verses.21: Say to the house of Israel, “Thus says the Lord God: I have defiled my holy places. The pride of your hearts and the joy of your souls will be destroyed. Your children and their children will also be destroyed.”
verses.22: And you shall do as I have done to their mouths. They shall not be able to speak. And the bread of manners shall they not be able to eat.
verses.23: And cover your heads with cloths, and cover your feet with cloths as well. Do not weep or mourn. And let your tears flow down from your eyes, and let each person go to his brother.
verses.24: And Jehizkiel will be a source of comfort to you, just as all those things that he did will also be beneficial to you. And you shall know that I am the servant of the LORD.
verses.25: And you, son of Adam, you were born on that day when I took away from them their pride and their arrogance. I also took away their lustful desires and their selfishness from them, along with their children and their daughters.
verses.26: On that day, the prophet will come to you so that your ears may hear.
verses.27: On that day, you will open your mouth and speak. Do not stop speaking anymore. Then you will be their Savior. They will know that I am Jehovah.
